head_commit.message:
#387 LAUNCHER-BAM-LOG-SAU-CAY-CHET r1 (packet A, Linux): run.json khai cay da chet hay chua luc bam log

Truoc: lenh_run bam stdout.log/stderr.log ngay sau p.wait(); chau con song
trong nhom van ghi tiep, so khong co truong nao noi bam lay luc nao.

- M1: ba khoa moi log_bam_cay_da_chet / log_bam_cho_giay / log_bam_luc_utc.
- M2: _cho_cay_chet_truoc_bam + _HAN_CHO_CAY_TRUOC_BAM_LOG = 10.0, mot deadline
  monotonic; doi TRUOC phep doc lai so (stop trong luc doi van duoc thay);
  ket_thuc_utc/thoi_luong_giay khong gom thoi gian doi; Ctrl-C trong luc doi
  thanh bi_ngat/130, ma_thoat giu ma that. _nen_do_cay_truoc_bam la cho duy
  nhat quyet nen: nen khac Linux tra False ngay, giu bieu thuc xoa prompt va
  moc ket_thuc cua base.
- M3: VERSION 1.6.0 -> 1.6.1.
- M4-M6: muoi mot ca r387_*, muoi sau dot bien DOT_BIEN, hai dot bien
  DOT_BIEN_HARNESS, mot neo sua (xoa_prompt_khi_wrapper_vua_thoat).

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015Gtxrb4huMrRxF2Lw4t79M
